newsitem.title: JAPAN: Takara Shuzo leaps on gene therapy agent.
newsitem.headline: Takara Shuzo leaps on gene therapy agent.

text.p: Takara Shuzo Co Ltd shares jumped in Friday morning trade, inspired by news that the firm will start selling a reagent for gene therapy in Japan and abroad from May 19, brokers said.
The shares rose 60 yen or 7.85 percent to 824 and were the second largest percentage gainer on the first section of the Tokyo bourse by midday.
The new product, RetroNectin, will be marketed by the Boehringer Ingelheim Bioproducts Partnership in Europe and by Panvera Corp in the United States, Takara Shuzo said in a statement.
